Mandatory Screening Parameters

Clinical_v2.0

Blood Pressure & Heart Rate

Hypertension (High BP) is a major risk factor at altitude. We screen for resting heart rate anomalies before ascent.

Oxygen Saturation (SpO2)

We monitor oxygen levels to detect early signs of hypoxia. Anything below 92% triggers a mandatory safety review.

"Hard Stop" Authority

Our medical team has the absolute authority to cancel a climb if vitals are unsafe. No refunds on safety, but full credits provided.
